scan.pinterest_status: Official Pinterest Newsroom, Pinterest Business guidance and public Pinterest board URLs were checked on 10 October 2026. The Newsroom's newest trend report remains the 6 October Beauty Trend Report. Q5 guidance reinforces intent-aware creative refreshes, everyday utility and 5–10 creative variants, but these behaviors are already covered by /performance-creative-mix, /trend-to-brand and existing product-ad/social controls. Public board pages were inaccessible today.
scan.chatgpt_status: Production v2.20.0 with 716 commands was read before any decision. No script change was materially justified. All 716 commands, 42 categories, 40 executable bundles, settings, personal creative intelligence, metadata and Firefox updater controls remain unchanged. The current release passed regression; browser installation remains locally observable only after userscript reload.
trends: Q5 audience intent shifts from gifting to self-purchase and from celebration to planning
post-holiday creative should replace deadline urgency with practical utility, routine, organisation, comfort and fresh-start outcomes
existing assets can be repositioned through headline, overlay, framing, imagery or product-selection changes instead of full reinvention
creative variety remains valuable, with Pinterest citing 5–10 ads per ad group as correlated with stronger ROAS
holiday creative continues to favor visual search readiness, multi-format campaigns, clear product feeds and full-funnel alignment
Beauty Guides and the Beauty Trend Report remain active visual-to-action and specificity signals already represented in the catalogue
skipped: No /q5-creative-reset command because the durable intent-shift, asset-reuse and variation behaviors already exist across /performance-creative-mix, /trend-to-brand, /variation and product/social controls
No additional holiday command because visual-search readiness, multi-format product ads, clear offers and full-funnel planning are already covered
No Beauty Guides or Beauty Trend Report additions because /beauty-trend-system already covers reference decoding, specificity, recreation planning and cross-format variants
No commands were derived from public Pinterest boards because the directly requested pages were inaccessible today

test.detail: All 15 current-release regression checks passed: syntax, version/build sync, catalogue count and uniqueness, /performance-creative-mix integrity, categories, bundles, bundle references, exact metadata parity, monitor/runtime anchors, update URLs, settings compatibility and Firefox updater controls.

deploy.detail: No userscript or metadata deployment was needed. This completed scan record is being published to main; public readback verification follows. Browser installation is not claimed.
